parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1 parameter set Marquis2019, exported to BPX by battinfo-records/scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py. PyBaMM's description: Parameters for a Kokam SLPB78205130H cell, from the paper.

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/2.0341915jes as implemented in PyBaMM's Marquis2019 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.2 mV RMS and 0.005% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C).
Separator porosity: 1 in PyBaMM; written as 1 - 1e-9 because PyBaMM's BPX importer divides by its logarithm.
